description: This file contains functions and types for searching and retrieving code chunks and text snippets from a database, including vector similarity and keyword search functionalities, specific to a memory management extension in a larger project.

methods.name: vectorToBlob
methods.description: Converts a number array (embedding) into a Buffer object.

methods.name: escapeLikePattern
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for SQL LIKE pattern matching.

methods.name: buildMatchQueryFromTerms
methods.description: Builds a match query string from an array of search terms.

methods.name: planKeywordSearch
methods.description: Prepares a search plan for keyword-based search, handling tokenization and query formation.

methods.name: searchVector
methods.description: Performs a vector similarity search in the database, returning the most relevant code chunks or text snippets.

methods.name: listChunks
methods.description: Retrieves code chunks from the database, including embeddings and metadata.

methods.name: searchKeyword
methods.description: Performs a keyword-based text search in the database, supporting BM25 ranking and substring matching.
